//: Story Phase 17 crew dialogue and inspects: the old crew remembered, the cut-outs, the reunion, adult supervision, the Bureau, Greyhook, Captain Minutes, the restraint, the mellow interlude, Thunderbottom, the beard, the catastrophe, and after.
pete.p17_after_1: pete: (looking at the yellow-brown dark) It'll lift, Captain. It always lifts. It just takes the night. Don't look at Garrick too long.
pete.p17_after_2: pete: Three cardboard ancients, a chicken with no feathers left, and a beard that breathes. I signed up for a merchant ship.
pete.p17_coffin_1: pete: (rewriting rules, slowly) Rule twenty-eight. No scissors near the captain. Rule twenty-nine: none near Garrick either.
pete.p17_thunder_1: pete: Thunderbottom. Seventh. I looked him up in Garrick's book. The other six are all in there too. All of them shouting.
pete.p17_restraint_1: pete: (two buckets, one wet sail) Conditions, Captain. Good conditions. Rule twenty-six: bucket. Rule twenty-seven: second bucket.
pete.p17_minutes_1: pete: (from outside the door, not coming in) Five Captain Minutes, he says. I'd have paid not to see it, Captain. Is that a Captain Minute? Is that how it works?
pete.p17_greyhook_1: pete: Greyhook Cove. I've heard of it. Nobody's been there in a hundred years. Ledger says that's good for the books. 'Less traffic.'
pete.p17_supervision_1: pete: She's moved the barrels, Captain. Again. I put them back. She moved them back. We're up to six.
pete.p17_reunion_1: pete: (bucket in his arms like a baby) Two more. Two more of them. Cardboard. Captain, I'm going to need more rules.
pete.p17_cutouts_1: pete: (quietly) He's not wrong to miss them, Captain. He's wrong about the cupboard. Nobody's wrong about missing people.
gristle.p17_after_1: gristle: She can't unfold her arms, Captain. Tilda. She's printed like that. I think she'd have them folded anyway.
gristle.p17_coffin_1: gristle: (holding his nose) The green one was lovely while it lasted. This one isn't lovely. This one's an opinion.
gristle.p17_mellow_1: gristle: (on a cushion) Do you know what I like, Captain? Cushions. Just, all of them. In general.
gristle.p17_greyhook_1: gristle: I'm not touching a sheet till you say, Captain. I don't care who's on the wheel. Unless it's the eyebrows.
gristle.p17_supervision_1: gristle: Haul in, let out, look like I mean it. I've meant it so hard, Captain. My arms mean it.
gristle.p17_reunion_1: gristle: (a long way from the hold) She looked at me, Captain. The cardboard one. With the eyebrows. I've been looked at by a shark. This was worse.
gristle.p17_cutouts_1: gristle: Brogath's drawn his mates on a box. One of them's only half coloured in. She looks friendly, Captain. Half of her.
bob.p17_after_1: bob: I've counted the papers that flew round the lamp. Two hundred and eleven. I'd like to un-count them.
bob.p17_coffin_1: bob: Rule thirty: if Brogath's bowing out, don't tell him he's bowing out. I wrote it on my hand.
bob.p17_greyhook_1: bob: (whispering) She asked me to brace for Greyhook, Captain. I nearly did. She's VERY convincing.
bob.p17_supervision_1: bob: I've been made Barrel Guard. It's not a real job. I'm taking it very seriously.
bob.p17_cutouts_1: bob: I counted the cut-outs. Five. I counted the crew he used to have. Five. Captain, I don't like the maths.
jim.p17_after_1: jim: (holding the ladle like a shield) I'm Jim. I'm just saying it. In case. I'm Jim.
jim.p17_thunder_1: jim: (very quietly) He said supper. About Agnes. I'm a cook, Captain. I'd never. I'd NEVER.
jim.p17_mellow_1: jim: (gazing into a bucket) There's so much room in here, Captain.
jim.p17_minutes_1: jim: (handing you a cup of something) Here, Captain. For the... for the five minutes. I put a sprig of mint in it. You need it more than the soup.
jim.p17_reunion_1: jim: Do they eat? Cardboard ones? Brogath eats oats. Do they want oats? I can do oats.
jim.p17_cutouts_1: jim: One of the cut-outs is a cook, Captain. With beans. Brogath says she'd have adored my galley. I've hidden the beans.
ned.p17_after_1: ned: I've been standing very straight all week, Captain. In case anybody's drawing me.
ned.p17_supervision_1: ned: The cardboard lady asked me if I was the anchor guard. I said no. She said 'pity, we had a good one once'.
ned.p17_cutouts_1: ned: There's another Ned, Captain? On a box? WOBBLY Ned? (a pause) I don't wobble. Do I wobble?
squawks.p17_after_1: squawks: Bad sock. Good chicken. Cardboard: three.
squawks.p17_coffin_2: squawks: (holding his breath, puffed up twice his size) ...
squawks.p17_mellow_1: squawks: (upside down on his perch, content) ...green.
squawks.p17_minutes_1: squawks: CAPTAIN MINUTE. CAPTAIN MINUTE. CAPTAIN MINUTE.
hale.p17_after_1: hale: The Sharkstorm went round the wrong way for a moment there, Captain. Then it remembered. Holding her.
hale.p17_mellow_1: hale: (staring up) The storm went green at the edges, Captain. Just for a bit. I'd like that noted.
hale.p17_greyhook_1: hale: (holding the wheel very tightly) I've got it, Captain. Lashed. Nobody's having it off me again.
hale.p17_supervision_1: hale: (beside the wheel, which he isn't holding) She took my wheel, Captain. She said 'stand down' and I did. I don't know why I did.
nell.p17: nell: I logged it: SHARKSTORM ON FIRE, BRIEFLY. Then: SHARKSTORM NOT ON FIRE. Then I had a lie down.
sully.p17: sully: There's three cardboard pirates aboard now. I asked if they need hammocks. They said they sleep standing up. Of course they do.
wick.p17: wick: The old cardboard lady told me to stand up straight. I'm in a hammock. I stood up straight in the hammock.
rook.p17: rook: Captain, the cardboard first mate challenged me to a drill. I lost. To CARDBOARD.
brask.p17: brask: Five Captain Minutes, they're saying. The whole ship's using it now. 'That took me three Captain Minutes.' It's catching on.
jory.p17: jory: The chicken's back! Again! With fewer feathers! She walked into my hammock and sat in it like she owned it!
mags.p17: mags: I'm knitting the chicken a whole jumper this time. She's going to need it.
quill.p17: quill: Twenty-nine rules for Brogath, eleven for the Fart Zone, and a sign that says NOT EVEN FOR FRIENDS. I'm running out of NAILS.
garrick.p17_after_1: garrick[businesslike]: I maintain the Beard Joint was a scientific success, Captain. The CATASTROPHE was a separate event. Different department.
garrick.p17_after_2: garrick[delighted]: I'm still the Grand Stenchmaster, Captain. I checked this morning. Both crowns. A little browner.
garrick.p17_coffin_1: garrick[delighted]: (sharpening something) Captain, have you had a look at your beard lately? Commercially?
garrick.p17_thunder_1: garrick: Thunderbottom. The Seventh. The Thunderbottoms are a very old wind, Captain. Very old, very loud and very hungry.
garrick.p17_restraint_1: garrick[businesslike]: The Grand Restraint? I've read about it. Nobody in the book's ever managed it. I'm sure he'll be the first. I'll be on deck.
garrick.p17_minutes_1: garrick[delighted]: Captain Minutes! A sovereign currency! Captain, do you know what you ARE now? You're a CENTRAL BANK.
garrick.p17_greyhook_1: garrick[businesslike]: An expedition, Captain! For the BOOKS! I've offered to chair the Expedition Committee. Tilda said no in a way I felt in my teeth.
garrick.p17_bureau_1: garrick[delighted]: A FIRST MATE in the queue at the Bureau! The Bureau's never been more prestigious. I'm putting it in the brochure.
garrick.p17_supervision_1: garrick[delighted]: Ledger and I have been discussing a merger, Captain. His MAYBE column and my portfolio. We think it's going to be very big. Maybe.
garrick.p17_reunion_1: garrick[alarmed]: TWO more Ancients? On MY ship? Captain, I'm the Grand Stenchmaster. Nobody told me there'd be a SEQUEL.
garrick.p17_cutouts_1: garrick[businesslike]: A cardboard crew, Captain. Have you considered the merchandising? Five cut-outs, a collectable set. I've drafted a box.
brogath.p17_after_1: brogath[proud]: (completely flat, completely calm) That was a GOOD one. Nobody's said so. I'm saying so.
brogath.p17_after_2: brogath[pleased]: Ledger, Tilda and me. And you, Captain. And Agnes. It's nearly a crew. It IS a crew.
brogath.p17_coffin_1: brogath[loaded]: (bowing out) In for four, Captain. Out for four. Tilda says. I'm doing it.
brogath.p17_thunder_1: brogath[mortified]: He said SUPPER, Captain. About Agnes. I'd have... I'd have... (very quietly) I'm not very good at being angry. I'm learning.
brogath.p17_restraint_1: brogath[proud]: I've been practising the Grand Restraint since breakfast, Captain. I'm nearly at lunch.
brogath.p17_minutes_1: brogath[thoughtful]: (sniffing the air near you) That's my Coffin Sock, isn't it. Out of the machine. Oh, I'm sorry. Is it in your beard?
brogath.p17_greyhook_1: brogath: The chair, Captain. I didn't know about the chair. (a pause) I'll sit in it. Every evening. If she wants.
brogath.p17_bureau_1: brogath[mortified]: (under a cushion) She asked for ME, Captain. Preferred provider. In front of the BUREAU.
brogath.p17_supervision_1: brogath[delighted]: They're GENIUSES. Did you see the barrels? Nobody's ever done the barrels like that.
brogath.p17_reunion_1: brogath[delighted]: (holding Ledger's flat hand in one flat hand and Tilda's in the other) I've got them back, Captain. I've GOT them back.
brogath.p17_cutouts_1: brogath[proud]: (on his knees by the gallery) Look, Captain. That's how Ned stood. That's EXACTLY how he stood.
ledger.p17_after_1: ledger[thoughtful]: I've opened a new column, Captain. AFTERWARDS. Everything in it is a liability. Except Brogath. He's in MAYBE. He's always in MAYBE.
ledger.p17_after_2: ledger[happy]: When we get out of the storm, Captain, Greyhook. The books. You'll see. We'll all be MAYBE-rich.
ledger.p17_coffin_1: ledger[worried]: (writing) BEAN INDEX: RISING. CAPTAIN: CONTRIBUTING. GARRICK: (I can't write what Garrick is).
ledger.p17_thunder_1: ledger[worried]: I tried to price a chicken once, Captain. In sixteen-ninety. Elsie hit me with a ladle. I've never tried again.
ledger.p17_mellow_1: ledger[mellow]: (holding up the ledger) Nought. Captain. Look at the nought. It's got nothing in it. That's the most beautiful thing.
ledger.p17_restraint_1: ledger[happy]: CONDITIONS: Breezy. FIRST MATE: Determined. PROVIDER: Pink. I'm keeping the minutes. (a pause) The ordinary kind.
ledger.p17_minutes_1: ledger[proud]: Five Captain Minutes! The first stable currency this ship has ever had. Backed by you, Captain. By your suffering. Rock solid.
ledger.p17_greyhook_1: ledger[determined]: Greyhook Cove. A sea chest. Twenty-one years of books. They'll have MATURED, Captain.
ledger.p17_greyhook_2: ledger[sad]: (quietly) I kept writing him down as an asset. After. Every month. Brogath, one, priceless. I couldn't put him anywhere else.
ledger.p17_bureau_1: ledger[thoughtful]: Ninety-seven pages! I've never filled in a form I didn't love. I've filled in some I didn't need to. I enjoyed those most.
ledger.p17_bureau_2: ledger[happy]: (to Tilda, across the room) Page sixty, Tilda! Lungs! I put MAYBE!
tilda[annoyed]: (without turning round) Put NO, Ledger.
ledger.p17_supervision_1: ledger[proud]: ASSETS: QUITE A LOT. That's progress, Captain. I've been doing books for four hundred years and that's the most specific I've ever been.
ledger.p17_reunion_1: ledger[confused]: Four hundred years, Captain. The interest alone. Is there anyone I should invoice?
tilda.p17_after_1: tilda[annoyed]: (upside down in the sashes, singed, arms still folded) I am FINE. Leave me here. I'm thinking.
tilda.p17_after_2: tilda[soft]: (touching the burnt corner) It was lit, though. It was properly lit. With him. (a pause) Never again. Probably.
tilda.p17_coffin_1: tilda[stern]: Stop SHOUTING at people, Stinkbeard. That's my job. And I'm not doing it right now, because he's BOWING.
tilda.p17_thunder_1: tilda[furious]: (very coldly) If he so much as LOOKS at that chicken again, Stinkbeard, I'll stop being mellow. I can do it. I've done it before.
tilda.p17_mellow_1: tilda[mellow]: (looking at her hand) Brogath drew this, you know. The thumb's wrong. I don't mind.
tilda.p17_restraint_1: tilda[determined]: Conditions, permit, provider. I've never been so organised for a cigarette.
tilda.p17_minutes_1: tilda[smug]: (to Ledger, about Captain Minutes) That's the first thing you've ever invented that I'd pay for, Ledger.
tilda.p17_greyhook_1: tilda[stern]: (quietly, not looking at the set) Eleven years, that chair. I'd do it again. Don't tell him I said so.
tilda.p17_greyhook_2: tilda[determined]: Two days east by north. I've plotted it. I plotted it four hundred years ago. It's still a good course.
tilda.p17_bureau_1: tilda[determined]: The old way, Stinkbeard. With him. I'll fill in a thousand pages.
tilda.p17_supervision_1: tilda[stern]: Barrels on deck look ready. Barrels in a hold look forgotten. I won't apologise for the barrels.
tilda.p17_reunion_1: tilda[furious]: Who drew my EYEBROWS? (a pause; she looks at Brogath; Brogath looks at the floor) ...They're good eyebrows.
visitor_one.p17_after_1: visitor_one: Everybody's furious, man. Except Brogath. He's so proud. It's beautiful. It's terrible.
visitor_one.p17_coffin_1: visitor_one: (with a wet cloth on his face) The green's gone, man. It's... it's a coffin again.
visitor_one.p17_mellow_1: visitor_one: (flat on the deck) The SECOND Chicken-Town, man. We're historians now.
visitor_one.p17_restraint_1: visitor_one: (holding a ladle) Correspondent One. Still embedded, man. Deep.
visitor_one.p17_reunion_1: visitor_one: Two more of them, man. Flat. Old. They hugged. I cried a bit. I'm still crying a bit.
visitor_one.p17_cutouts_1: visitor_one: Brogath's making his friends out of a box, man. That's the most beautiful thing I've ever seen. And the scariest.
visitor_two.p17_after_1: visitor_two: He called Jim a PRINCESS, bro. I'm putting that on a sash too.
visitor_two.p17_coffin_1: visitor_two: (gagging) Bro. BRO. It's a sock, bro. In a coffin. In my FACE.
visitor_two.p17_mellow_1: visitor_two: I'm not a historian, bro. I'm a VIBE.
visitor_two.p17_restraint_1: visitor_two: (with a spoon) Correspondent Two! We were on the KING'S SHOW, bro! We're FAMOUS in a STORM!
visitor_two.p17_reunion_1: visitor_two: BRO. CARDBOARD PEOPLE. I'm getting it on a sash.
visitor_two.p17_cutouts_1: visitor_two: Bro, the cook one's only half coloured in. That's so SAD, bro.
ledger.idle: ledger[happy]: (looking up from the ledger) Captain! Everything's in order. Well. Everything's in a column.

then: tilda[stern]: (arms folded, the burnt corner turned away from you) What.

bureau_puffington.p17: bureau_puffington: (very small handwriting, page forty-two) The traditional method, dear. I've been in this queue since your Lord Puffchester. I'm in no hurry. (glancing at Tilda) She can go first. I think she'd better.
agnes_second.p17: Fewer feathers. The rest standing up. One eye going one way, one the other. She pecks your boot, misses, pecks it again, and looks very pleased with herself.
p17.inspect.cutout_jeb: OLD JEB RATTLEPLANK. One eye drawn, one EYE T.B.C. Somebody (Brogath) has tucked a little paper price tag into his tray: NOT FOR SALE. Underneath, very small: (HE'D SELL IT ANYWAY).
p17.inspect.cutout_ned: WOBBLY NED. Still leaning. Brogath has wrapped a sash round his shoulders, in case he's cold. He's cardboard. Brogath knows. He did it anyway.
p17.inspect.cutout_elsie: ELSIE BEANWRIGHT. Half coloured in. Brogath has drawn her a fifth smile, very small, in the corner, as a spare.
p17.inspect.converter_banned: THE GRAND CURRENCY CONVERTER, planked over. NO CONVERSIONS. NONE. EVER. BY ORDER OF THE CAPTAIN (5 MINUTES). The horn is still pointing at where your face was.

then: The board, blown flat against the wall. COFFIN SOCK EVENT: PENDING, it still says, in letters a foot high. Somebody has crossed out PENDING and written HAPPENED.

p17.inspect.sash_screen: Garrick's sash screen. Behind it: a saucer with something black and curled in it, a pair of scissors and a cap off a Frog Grog flask. You don't look any closer. You don't need to. You were there.
p17.inspect.door: The treasure-room door. Every plank back, two more across them, Pete's sixth sign over the lot: NOT EVEN FOR FRIENDS. Behind it, now and then, something growls, quietly, like an old dog dreaming. It holds.
p17.inspect.ledger_books: Ledger's books, squared off on the mess table. On top of them, in his beautiful hand: MAYBE (CONTINUED).
p17.inspect.helm_log: The helm log on its post by the wheel. Your name back in it, under a hard, straight line in somebody else's hand: HELM RETURNED (UNDER PROTEST). T.
p17.inspect.fz_scorch: Scorch marks round the release circle and up under the portholes, where the Fire-Waft went out. The room held. It's worn. It's still a room.
